description: Elevate your driving experience with this stunning 2024 Mazda CX-50 2.5 Turbo Premium Plus Package. This exceptional SUV combines bold style, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, making it the perfect companion for your adventures.  - Wind Chill Pearl Paint Charge - Cargo Package (Cargo Net, Cargo Blocks) - Carpet Cargo Mat  Beneath the sleek exterior lies a powerful 2.5L I4 Turbocharged engine that delivers an impressive 227 horsepower, effortlessly propelling you through the urban landscape or the open road. With its seamless 6-speed automatic transmission and standard all-wheel-drive system, you'll enjoy a confident and responsive driving experience, no matter the conditions.  The CX-50's impressive fuel efficiency, with an EPA-estimated 23 mpg in the city and 29 mpg on the highway, ensures you can go further on every tank, making it an economical choice without sacrificing performance.  Step inside and you'll be surrounded by premium amenities, including a Bose 12-speaker audio system, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a state-of-the-art Mazda Connect infotainment system with navigation. The heated and ventilated front seats, along with the heated steering wheel, will keep you comfortable in any weather, while the power liftgate and ample cargo space make it easy to accommodate all your gear.  Safety is also a top priority, with features like blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, and Mazda's i-Activsense safety suite, which includes adaptive cruise control, lane-keep assist, and automatic emergency braking.
